subject: Recap & pricing options: milestone-based volume steps and route mix
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finquick.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Recap & pricing options: milestone-based volume steps and route mix

Hi Sam — great conversation today. Quick written recap and the asks we agreed on so we have a clear next-step list.

Call highlights
- Current baseline: ~18M gen tokens / month + 7M embedding tokens / month (avg over last 3 months).
- Near-term plan: add a reranking route for search results (expected 1.5 x multiplier on embedding tokens) and a new assistant model for customer support (higher per-token cost).
- Expansion profile you gave: 3 phases — Phase A (0–6m): 50–100M tokens/mo; Phase B (6–12m): 100–400M; Phase C (12–24m): 400M–1B+.
- Target budget you called out: $10k–$25k/month initially, with willingness to commit to 12–24 months for unit economics.

What we (Redwood) will provide
- Pricing scenarios using milestone step-ups (effective $/1M tokens at key thresholds) and blended rates when multiple routes/models are in use.
- An example blended calc: we show how reranking (low cost / high volume) + instruction generation (higher cost) combine into an effective $/1M.
- A draft MAP and a spreadsheet with line-item unit economics attached (FinQuick-MAP-v2.pdf, price-breakdown.xlsx).

Open asks for you (to confirm by EOD Thu 2027-04-29)
1) Confirm expected monthly token mix by route for Phase A and Phase B (rough ranges OK).
2) Confirm whether FinQuick wants a 12- or 24-month committed term (we can present acceleration credit for longer commits).
3) Any procurement/PO timing constraints — you mentioned legal prefers PO + signature by mid-May.

Proposed next steps
- You confirm volumes → we run a blended scenario and formal quote (2 business days).
- If numbers align, we route to procurement for signature and agree a kickoff window.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and a simple price spreadsheet. Happy to hop on a short follow-up if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: FinQuick-MAP-v2.pdf (1 page); price-breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finquick.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: FinQuick Procurement <procure@finquick.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 17:02:13 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing options: milestone-based volume steps and route mix

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A couple clarifications from our side:

- For Phase A (first 3 months of expansion) we expect ~60M tokens/mo split roughly 70% gen / 30% embeddings (post-reranking). Phase B ramps to ~220M/mo (60/40 gen/emb).
- Can you provide both: (a) the raw milestone unit prices (e.g., $/1M tokens at 100M, 400M, 1B thresholds) and (b) a blended effective $/1M when we mix gen + embedding + rerank? We need the blended view for our finance team.
- Also: if we add a new model route mid-term (e.g., a specialized summarization route), how are those accounted for in the blended rate? Will they be included in the next milestone calc or treated as an add-on?

Procurement note: legal wants to see an example clause for adding routes mid-term. If you can include a short language that says new routes get folded into blended calc at the next billing period unless otherwise agreed, that should work.

We aim to confirm Phase A volumes and term (likely 24 months) by Thu. Will wait for the detailed price scenarios.

—Sam
Sam Lee | Head of Platform Partnerships, FinQuick
sam.lee@finquick.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finquick.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 19:08:45 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing options: milestone-based volume steps and route mix

Sam — thanks. Below is a concise set of scenarios and a worked blended example; I'll follow with the spreadsheet that has line-item math.

Milestone unit prices (example, per 1M tokens) — generation route / embeddings & rerank (approx):
- 0–100M: $140 (gen), $18 (embeddings/rerank)
- 100M–400M: $110 (gen), $14 (emb/rerank)
- 400M–1B: $85 (gen), $9 (emb/rerank)

Committed term accelerator: we can offer an additional 10% credit on the per-1M unit rates for a 24-month firm commitment (applies across milestone bands).

Blended example (Phase B numbers you gave: 220M total, 60/40 gen/emb):
- Gen tokens: 132M -> pricing: first 100M @ $140 = 100*$140 = $14,000; remaining 32M @ $110 = 32*$110 = $3,520
- Embedding/rerank tokens: 88M -> all in 0–100M band @ $18 = 88*$18 = $1,584
- Raw monthly cost = $14,000 + $3,520 + $1,584 = $19,104
- Effective $/1M = $19,104 / 220 = $86.84 per 1M tokens (raw)
- With 24-month commit credit (10%) -> effective $/1M = $78.16

How new routes are treated
- Default: new routes are folded into the blended calculation at the next billing period and counted toward cumulative monthly volumes for milestone thresholds. If a customer needs a carve-out (e.g., trial route excluded), we can document that in the SOW.

Notes / operational caveats
- Blended math is done at the account/route granularity monthly; overage or step-up triggers are evaluated at month-end.
- Very high-volume bursts that materially change long-term profile (e.g., sustained >1B/mo) will be re-evaluated and may move to a custom contract.

I attached the price-breakdown.xlsx with the cell-level math and an alternate scenario sheet that shows 12 vs 24 month compares. If you're good with this, we'll produce a formal quote in HubSpot and route to procurement.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: price-breakdown.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: approval ask — FinQuick DQ-7893 (commit accelerator + route add policy)

Quick internal note — Sam is leaning to 24 months. Proposed commercial approach:
- Keep milestone bands listed above.
- Offer 10% accelerator for 24-month firm term (standard, applied across bands).
- Standard route-add language: new routes folded into blended calc month-after-add; exceptions require SOW.

Need from Priyom: sign-off on applying accelerator credit (legal/commercial) and any notes on SSO/KMS handling for Private if they ask.
From Rafael: confirm we can support reranking route at anticipated QPS and whether we need to cap burst credits for first 90 days.

If we get thumbs-up today, I'll push the formal quote and include the route-add clause for legal to review.

Thanks — Ben

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finquick.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: FinQuick Procurement <procure@finquick.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing options: milestone-based volume steps and route mix

Appreciate the clear examples — that blended worked example is exactly what finance needs.

We are comfortable proceeding on a 24-month committed term with the 10% accelerator applied. Procurement asked for the route-add clause in writing (copy below is fine):

"New model or route additions will be included in the account's blended pricing calculation at the start of the subsequent billing period. If the parties wish to exclude a route from blended pricing or apply special pricing, such exclusions must be documented in a mutually executed SOW prior to inclusion."

Please go ahead and send the formal quote + DocuSign. We aim to have countersigned by 2027-05-14.

—Sam
